subject: Request: redacted training & screening artifacts for SOC 2 / SIG review
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmecorp.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2/SIG evidence request — employee training + screening samples

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the quick walkthrough yesterday. As part of AcmeCorp's continuous vendor risk checks we're putting together an evidence packet for your SOC 2 / SIG review. Our auditor has asked specifically for a small, representative sample of operational evidence around employee screening and training. Can you provide the following items by next week (8/10) if possible?

- A CSV export of completed security training for the past 12 months (employee, course, completion date, cert id).
- Redacted copies or a zipped sample of pre-employment background checks (redactions acceptable for PII; we need proof of completion, scope, and vendor).
- Offboarding events export showing last 12 months (employee id, last day, access deprovision date).
- A signed template of your employee security attestation used in onboarding.

For context: the auditor will want linkage between training completion and active employee rosters, and sample redactions should demonstrate that original sources exist and were reviewed. If any items are sensitive, a hashed identifier with a separate mapping key (sent via secure link) is fine.

Let me know if you need a formal DocuSign request or if we should accept these via SFTP/secure Drive. Our auditor is Priya Desai (pri...@auditplus.com) and they requested samples, not a full export.

Best,
Sara
Sara Khan
Vendor Risk | AcmeCorp
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request — employee training + screening samples

Thanks Sara — we can do that. A few clarifying questions so we scope precisely:

1) Sample size: do you want 5–10 redacted background checks or one per employee role level (IC, manager, senior)?
2) For the training CSV, is a machine-readable CSV fine (we can redact employee emails and use employee IDs)?
3) Offboarding export: do you need all leavers or just those who had access to production systems?

Marissa (HR ops) I'm looping you in to confirm the background check vendor and to pull the signed attestation template. Stephanie — could you confirm the offboarding export fields we typically provide for SOC requests?

We can deliver a zipped package and share over a secure Drive link. Targeting 8/10 EOD for a sample bundle unless you need it sooner.

-Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance Ops
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmecorp.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request — employee training + screening samples

Hi all,

We can assemble the items requested. Here's what HR will provide and how we'll redact/format:

- Redacted background checks: we will provide 6 samples (two ICs, two managers, two senior ICs). We'll remove names and SSNs and replace them with a stable SHA256 hash per employee (mapping file will be shared separately via our secure DocuSign link). Attachment stub: redacted_background_checks_ACME_sample.zip (contains PDFs with redaction banners).

- Training export: CSV with columns [employee_id, role, course_name, completion_date, certificate_id]. We will replace employee email with employee_id; emails are not needed. Attachment stub: training_completion_Q2_2027.csv.

- Offboarding events: we'll include all leavers for the past 12 months plus a flag for 'prod_access' so you can filter. Attachment stub: offboarding_events_export_2026-2027.csv.

- Employee attestation: signed template used at onboarding (redacted signatures preserved where required). Attachment stub: employee_attestation_signed_template.pdf.

One note on timelines: background check vendor (ClearScreen) requires internal approvals before we can distribute PDFs externally; this will be done today. We will redact at HR and perform a quick QA.

Proposed delivery: initial Drive link with CSVs + offboarding export by 8/10 COB Pacific; redacted background PDFs to follow within 24 hours after HR QA (likely 8/11). If your auditor requires all artifacts by 8/10, we can escalate.

Marissa
HR Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@auditplus.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmecorp.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 10:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request — employee training + screening samples

Hi Kimberly / Marissa — thanks for the quick coordination. A couple clarifications from AuditPlus:

- Sample size is fine (6 PDFs). Please include the background check cover page that shows scope and vendor confirmation.
- For the mapping between hashed IDs and original employees, we do not need the mapping file unless AcmeCorp needs it; a hashed id is acceptable for review.
- Please ensure training CSV uses ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) for completion_date.
- For offboarding, the auditor will want a field showing when access to production systems was revoked; if that exact date isn't captured, a 'deprovisioned_within_days' integer is acceptable.

Finally, Sara — if you can send a DocuSign request for the HR attestation acceptance that will speed the signed-template exchange (we can accept the PDF as evidence as well).

Thanks,
Priya
Senior Auditor | AuditPlus
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sara Khan <sara.khan@acmecorp.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@auditplus.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2/SIG evidence request — employee training + screening samples

Hi Sara / Priya — quick status update and delivery plan:

1) training_completion_Q2_2027.csv — attached and uploaded to secure Drive link (see related_links). CSV uses employee_id, role, course_name, completion_date (ISO), certificate_id.
2) offboarding_events_export_2026-2027.csv — attached; includes 'prod_access' boolean and 'deprovisioned_within_days' where exact revoke dates are not in the HR system.
3) employee_attestation_signed_template.pdf — attached.
4) redacted_background_checks_ACME_sample.zip — HR completed QA; given vendor terms we will share the zip via the DocuSign-secured transfer link later today (expected by 18:00 PT).

We will not share any clear-text PII in email. Mapping keys (SHA256 hashes -> employee ids) will be transmitted to AcmeCorp's secure intake (DocuSign secure field) if requested by your auditor.

If you need anything else (additional role samples or extended date ranges), reply on this thread and we'll prioritize.

Thanks — Kim
--
